actions.text: INTRUDER. THE EAST GATE IS SEALED UNTIL I AM UNMADE. STATE YOUR ENDING.
...you smell like the other side. Like the rift. Good.
THE CORE IS NOT FOR YOU. THE CORE IS NOT FOR ANYONE.
THE SHARD IS NOT TO BE CARRIED. THE SHARD IS NOT TO BE TOUCHED.
VISITORS WITHOUT A KEY ARE TO BE UNMADE.
It is quiet. The Shard stopped singing the moment the Warden fell.
The heart of it is still warm, though. Whatever carried it here left a trail, and the trail leads further than this base.
And Kael... the Shard hummed when you walked past it. Not for me. Not for the Warden. For you.
Old machinery. Static.
I am a scholar. I do not believe in static.
Let's go back up and tell Rhea. This was only the first piece.
A lattice unit unfolds from a wall niche, its repair arms humming. 'PATIENT DETECTED. PREPARING... TREATMENT.'
The floor ripples. A swollen leech the size of a cart slides up out of a drain, tasting the air.
THE SHARD VAULT. THE WALKWAYS WERE LAID OVER NOTHING SO THAT NOTHING COULD BE HIDDEN ON THEM. THREE WARDENS KEEP THREE ROADS. THE FOURTH ROAD IS KEPT BY THE FIRST WARDEN OF ALL.
WEST ROAD. THE SENTINEL MARCHES THE LOOPS. THE MAZE WAS MADE TO TIRE THE LIVING; THE SENTINEL HAS NEVER BEEN TIRED.
EAST ROAD. THE PHASE STALKER HUNTS BY SMELL. IT HAS LEARNED THE SMELL OF THE OTHER SIDE, AND YOU SMELL OF IT.
NORTH ROAD. THE COLOSSUS STANDS AT THE DOOR TO THE CORE. IT WAS NOT BUILT TO KEEP YOU OUT. IT WAS BUILT TO KEEP SOMETHING IN.
The stone hums against your palm. Across the void, the guardians reset and the sealed gates slide shut.
